scope: End-to-end search-only comparison of deployed CPU and combined CUDA modes. Different FP32 results and batch concurrency can produce different search trees; not identical-work kernel acceleration.

method.mode_order: CPU then CUDA for seeds 0 and 2; CUDA then CPU for seed 1
method.timed_region: search.search only; setup, observation construction, metadata hashing and teardown excluded
method.cuda_mode: Posegen plus all placement simulation, no CPU retries; initialization/scoring/filtering remain CPU
method.profile_overrides: Only posegen backend and root CEM seed change between runs; current budgets and physics retained
